==Overview==
The '''Google Play ASL Season 22''' ('''Google Play ASL 시즌22''') , is an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[SOOP]].

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AbqImJS8XQM</embedvideo>

==Tournament Information==
===Format===
* '''Round of 24: Group stage'''
** [[Dual tournament]] format: {{abbr/Bo1}}
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Round of 16: Group stage'''
** 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[ASL/21|ASL Season 21]]
** [[Dual tournament]] format: First two matches: {{abbr/Bo1}} - Final three matches: {{abbr/Bo3}}
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Round of 8: Elimination Stage'''
** Eight player single-elimination bracket
** Quarterfinals {{abbr/Bo5}}; semifinals and finals {{abbr/Bo7}}
